# Qwen2.5 7B Instruct

Alibaba · released 2024-09 · 7.62B params · apache-2.0

**score 29.3** ±1.3

#185 of 205 · from 15 benchmark results across 10 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

api (Together AI (Turbo)) · $0.30/M blended · $0.3 in / $0.3 out per 1M tokens · [www.together.ai ↗](https://www.together.ai/pricing)

[price source](https://www.together.ai/pricing) · USD per 1M tokens, Together AI serverless inference, "Qwen2.5 7B Instruct Turbo" (Together optimized serving endpoint of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; its quantization may differ from the reference BF16 weights). Batch and dedicated endpoints excluded. Currency: USD. Together AI official pricing page, observed 2026-09-25.

[context specification source](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/blob/a09a35458c702b33eeacc393d103063234e8bc28/README.md) · Full supported model-card context requires the documented YaRN configuration beyond the default 32,768 tokens. This does not promise the same limit on every hosted API.

| local download | size | score | command |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 4-bit q4\_k\_m | ~5.07GB | 29.3 | `ollama run qwen2.5:7b` |
| 8-bit q8\_0 | ~9.64GB | 29.3 | `ollama run qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q8_0` |

The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.
